issues.description: The problem statement / UML requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This discrepancy can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause tests or examples that assume the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order in the solution match the UML and problem statement: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... }. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly state the constructor parameter order used in the solution if that order is intentional.
